description:
We are three students from Dnipro, Ukraine. We love space, games, and learning new things. We are building a digital card game called "Deck of Space's Destiny". 
We can do creative design and simple coding (JavaScript/HTML). We are fast learners and ready to work hard! We are a friendly and positive team with a clear idea. 
We want to finish our project in 48 hours and have fun!
summary: Deck of Space’s Destiny is an interactive educational game about preparing space expeditions to the Moon and Mars. Players choose a mission, select the necessary resources using special cards, and manage a limited budget. Each mission has its own conditions and challenges that players must consider when planning. The game also includes achievements, a card collection, and a progression system. The project helps players learn about space exploration in an accessible and engaging way while developing logical thinking, planning skills, and the ability to use resources efficiently. Our goal is to make learning about space more interesting and interactive.
details:
Deck of Space’s Destiny is an educational interactive game focused on planning space expeditions.
At the beginning of the game, players choose one of two missions: a journey to the Moon or to Mars. Each mission has specific conditions and a budget. Players must select suitable resources using cards, taking into account their costs and purposes. The system calculates the total expenses and the remaining budget. Once the preparation is complete, players can launch their expedition. The Mars mission becomes available after successfully completing the Moon mission.
The game includes a main menu, mission selection, resource cards, a budget calculation system, achievements, and a card collection. These features make the learning process more engaging and help players understand the importance of planning and effective resource allocation when preparing space expeditions.
The project’s main advantages are its interactivity, accessible presentation of information, and combination of education and gameplay. We hope that the game will spark children’s and teenagers’ interest in space exploration. In the future, it could also be used in educational activities and during planetarium visits.
The creativity of our project lies in allowing players to become part of the expedition preparation process. Instead of simply reading about space, they make their own decisions, choose resources, and manage expenses.
During development, our team considered the specific conditions of each mission, limited resources and budgets, crew living conditions, and the convenience and clarity of the game interface.
